title: The work circuit: how one ticket matures from a point into an addressable node
note: A ticket does not move OPEN -> BUILT -> WITNESSED -> RATIFIED. That is the standing of a claim about the ticket, and it says nothing about what the ticket has become. This circuit is the second axis: how far the thing itself has been drawn. A ticket enters as a named point and leaves as a surface that can be addressed, called, and held to account. Standing and stage are independent - a CAPABLE_NODE stage can sit at OPEN standing, and a ROOT_POINT can be RATIFIED as a point. Confusing the two is what let this repository accumulate ratified vocabulary over undrawn work.

rules.monotonic: A ticket advances one stage at a time. Skipping a stage is refused by SKIPPED_STAGE, because each stage admission predicate is the previous stage evidence.
rules.regression_allowed: A ticket may fall back when a defeating case fires. Falling back is recorded, not hidden, and is the ordinary outcome of a real observation.
rules.stage_is_not_standing: Advancing a stage is a claim about the artifact and carries the same witness rule as any other claim: the participant that drew the stage may not settle it.
rules.target_stage: A custody declares the stage its initiative must reach. Not every initiative must reach CAPABLE_NODE, and declaring a target below the top is the ordinary case rather than an admission of failure.

stages.means: A named point of concern with an address and a root. It has no extent: nobody can yet say how big it is, and saying so would be invention.
admits_when: the ticket names exactly one subject address
the ticket names at least one root - a product ground claim, a decision record, a Phase-I requirement, or an open seam
stages.evidence: the subject address resolves, and every named root resolves to a real record

defeated_by.means: a ticket that names no root, or names one that does not resolve
defeated_by.why: work with no product ground behind it cannot be scoped, prioritised or abandoned on evidence, only on opinion

stages.means: The point drawn along a closed path: the thinnest end-to-end traversal of every layer the concern touches, returning to its origin as a re-runnable check.
admits_when: the ticket names an ordered path of layers it traverses
the path is closed - the last layer produces evidence a machine can re-run against the first layer precondition
stages.evidence: the declared check runs and its result is derived from the run, never written by the participant that ran it

defeated_by.means: a slice whose last layer emits a report rather than a check
defeated_by.why: GROUND-010 - a report is not an observation. A path that ends in a self-report has not closed, and every later stage built over it inherits the gap

stages.means: The slice given extent, and composed with sibling verticals into one surface. Extent is the estimate: the first stage at which the work can honestly be sized.
admits_when: at least two closed verticals share a declared boundary
the ticket carries an estimate under soveraeign-estimate/v1 on every dimension the circuit requires
stages.evidence: each composed vertical is independently at VERTICAL_SLICE or above, and the estimate validates

defeated_by.means: a surface composed from verticals that are not themselves closed
defeated_by.why: composition multiplies the gap. Two open paths joined into a surface produce one surface nobody can check, and the join hides which half failed

stages.means: The surface opened into named endpoints behind a context-addressable boundary. A participant arriving with no briefing can discover what may be asked of it and reach exactly that.
admits_when: every operation on the surface declares subject, verb, endpoint, preconditions, commit and refusals under soveraeign-service-manifest/v1
the boundary answers discovery from the capability projection rather than from a second hand-kept list
what discovery advertises and what the endpoint enforces are the same set
stages.evidence: the discovery answer and the enforcement check are read through independent paths and agree

defeated_by.means: an endpoint discovery advertises with an authority the endpoint does not check, or an endpoint reachable but absent from discovery
defeated_by.why: the live instance of this defect is nine BUILT console operations that declare an authority and check none, console.grant and console.revoke among them. The surface looked complete from either side alone

stages.means: The exploded surface carrying identity, typed authority, receipts and continuity, so it can be addressed as a node or as a subnode of another node.
admits_when: the surface holds an admitted node identity rather than an inferred one
every declared operation checks a typed, scoped, live grant
every crossing leaves a receipt naming actor, operation, authority, inputs, outputs and effect class
an independent participant that did not build it has observed it
stages.evidence: an observation from a participant with no build relation to the node, resolved from the run record rather than declared by the observer

defeated_by.means: a node whose only observation comes from a participant inside its own build, or whose identity is inferred from operating successfully rather than admitted
defeated_by.why: operating successfully is not authority and not identity. A node that witnesses itself has closed its own circuit with itself at both ends

refusals.SKIPPED_STAGE: a ticket advanced more than one stage in a single transition
refusals.ROOTLESS_POINT: ROOT_POINT admission with no resolving root
refusals.OPEN_PATH: VERTICAL_SLICE admission whose path ends in a self-report
refusals.SURFACE_OVER_OPEN_PATHS: HORIZONTAL_SURFACE admission over verticals below VERTICAL_SLICE
refusals.MISSING_EXTENT: HORIZONTAL_SURFACE admission with no estimate on a required dimension
refusals.ADVERTISED_NOT_ENFORCED: EXPLODED_SURFACE admission where discovery and enforcement disagree
refusals.SELF_WITNESSED_NODE: CAPABLE_NODE admission observed only from inside its own build
refusals.UNKNOWN_STAGE: a stage name this circuit does not declare
